title.zh: 量测闭环：SIMS与片阻回答不同问题
title.en: Closing the metrology loop: SIMS and sheet resistance answer different questions

subtitle.zh: 剂量 /总浓度 /活性载流子/电性结果
subtitle.en: Dose / total concentration / active carriers / electrical results

body.zh: 从剂量到电性，建立量测闭环，用于验证工艺、定位异常与批次处置，；各量测回答不同问题，不能相互替代。
body.en: Build a dose-to-electrical metrology loop to validate processes, locate anomalies and disposition lots Each measurement answers a different question and cannot replace the others

body.zh: 不同的量测口径；协同验证工艺效果
body.en: Different measurement definitions jointly verify process results

body.zh: 1 读取束流剂量；通过Faraday杯；积分离子束流，；得到注入剂量。
body.en: 1 Read beam dose Use a Faraday cup Integrate ion beam current, to obtain implant dose

body.zh: 检查机台状态、；工艺条件与晶圆来料；信息，确保量测可比；与可追溯。
body.en: Check tool status, process conditions and incoming-wafer information to ensure comparability and traceability

body.zh: 采用二次离子质谱；总原子浓度深度分布。
body.en: Use secondary-ion mass spectrometry total atomic concentration versus depth

body.zh: 4 片阻或Hall测电学；通过片阻或霍尔测试；获取电学参数，反映；迁移率的综合结果。
body.en: 4 Measure electrical properties by sheet resistance or Hall Use sheet-resistance or Hall tests Obtain electrical parameters reflecting the combined effects of mobility

body.zh: 结合电学与结构量测；评估结深、掺杂轮廓；及器件关键电性。
body.en: Combine electrical and structural measurements Evaluate junction depth, dopant profile and key device electrical properties

body.zh: 6 SPC与异常处置；通过统计过程控制；监控关键指标，；识别异常并进行；批次处置。
body.en: 6 SPC and abnormal-lot disposition Use statistical process control to monitor key metrics, identify abnormalities and disposition lots

body.zh: 总浓度与活性口径；• SIMS测的是总原子浓度；• 电学反映活性载流子；•两者物理意义不同
body.en: Total concentration versus active carriers • SIMS measures total atomic concentration • Electrical measurements reflect active carriers • Their physical meanings differ

body.zh: 监控片与采样位置；•合理设置监控片；• 明确采样位置与频次；•关注片内与片间差异
body.en: Monitor wafers and sampling positions • Choose monitor wafers appropriately • Specify sampling locations and frequency • Track within-wafer and wafer-to-wafer differences

body.zh: 量测校准；• 定期校准与标样比对；• 确认量测线性与重复性；• 不同量测方法需独立校准
body.en: Metrology calibration • Calibrate regularly against standards • Confirm linearity and repeatability • Calibrate different methods independently

body.zh: 控制限与批次处置；•建立合理的控制限；• 区分随机波动与异常；• 按流程进行批次评估与处置
body.en: Control limits and lot disposition • Establish reasonable control limits • Distinguish random variation from abnormalities • Follow procedures for lot evaluation and disposition

body.zh: SIMS总原子浓度；电学活性浓度；SIMS给出杂质的“总量”；电学反映其中“有多大比例被激活”；两者不能互相替代；需结合使用，才能全面判断工艺结果。
body.en: SIMS total atomic concentration Electrically active concentration SIMS gives the total amount of impurities Electrical measurements reflect the activated proportion Neither replaces the other Use both to assess process results comprehensively

body.zh: 片阻改善也可能伴随扩散和结深增加；提高激活程度可能降低片阻，；但也可能导致杂质进一步扩散，；使结深增加，需综合评估电学、；结构与器件电性。
body.en: Lower sheet resistance may accompany diffusion and deeper junctions Greater activation may lower sheet resistance, but may also cause further impurity diffusion, increasing junction depth; assess electrical, structural and device properties together

body.zh: 剂量正常但深度错误；束流积分正常，但能量或角度异常导致深度偏差。
body.en: Correct dose but wrong depth Normal beam integral but abnormal energy or angle produces depth error

body.zh: SIMS合格但激活不足；总浓度达标，但活性载流子浓度偏低，片阻偏高。
body.en: Acceptable SIMS but insufficient activation Total concentration meets target but active-carrier concentration is low and sheet resistance high

body.zh: 平均片阻掩盖不均；仅看平均值可能忽略片内或片间不均匀性。
body.en: Average sheet resistance hides nonuniformity An average alone can hide within-wafer or wafer-to-wafer variation

body.zh: 量测机系统偏差；设备漂移、校准不良或量测条件变化导致系统性偏差。
body.en: Systematic metrology bias Tool drift, poor calibration or changed measurement conditions cause systematic bias

body.zh: 量测反馈链路 从物理量到器件表现，逐级验证，定位问题
body.en: Metrology feedback chain: verify from physical quantities to device performance and locate problems

body.zh: Faraday：束流剂量；实际注入的剂量有多少
body.en: Faraday: beam dose How much dose was actually implanted?

body.zh: SIMS：总浓度；杂质在深度方向如何分布
body.en: SIMS: total concentration How are impurities distributed with depth?

body.zh: 片阻/Hall：电学响应；有多少载流子被激活
body.en: Sheet resistance / Hall: electrical response How many carriers are activated?

body.zh: 器件电性；最终器件性能如何
body.en: Device electrical properties How does the final device perform?

body.zh: 多维数据交叉验证；快速定位问题根因；支撑工艺与批次决策；稳定提升产品良率；数据关联•定位异常•持续优化
body.en: Cross-validate multidimensional data Locate root causes quickly Support process and lot decisions Improve product yield consistently Correlate data · locate anomalies · continually optimize
